title: Bai 4
en: What do you usually do after school?
Write a sentence for each day of the week.
Use these adverbs: usually, sometimes, often, always, never
Now ask and answer questions using "How often...?"
How often do you study in the library after school?
- I always study in the library after school.
- On Mondays, I usually play badminton with some friends after school.
- On Tuesdays, I sometimes go to the library after school.
- On Wednesdays, I often go swimming after school.
- On Thursdays, I usually go to my English club after school.
- On Fridays, I sometimes play video games with my friends after school.
- On Saturdays, I always visit my grandparents after school.
- I never go to the movies after school.

title: Bai 5
en: The students of class 7A enjoy different activities after school hours.
She is a member of the school theater group.
At present, her group is rehearsing a play for the school anniversary celebration.
Ba is the president of the stamp collectors club.
On Wednesday afternoons, he and his friends get together and talk about their stamps.
If they have any new stamps, they usually bring them to school.
Ba's American friend, Liz, gives him a lot of American stamps.
In the afternoon, he usually goes home and watches videos.
Sometimes he reads a library book or comics,
but most of the time he lies on the couch in front of the TV.
